name: PrepWise
shortDescription: Interview prep with question filters, mock sessions, timer and spaced review.
features: Question bank filtered by company, role and difficulty
Mock interview mode with countdown timer and suggested per-question pace
Self-assessment scores (labelled as learner estimates, never verified performance)
Spaced review with Leitner-style boxes and visible due queue (nothing silently overdue)
Answer templates shown in bank; session notes
knownLimitations: Demo content simulated; no real company question sets
Spaced review is a simple heuristic, not validated spaced-repetition research
